name: Debian
initializeCommand: if [ -z "$HOME" ]; then echo 'devcontainer FATAL: HOME is unset on the host. The Wolfram bind mounts in .devcontainer/devcontainer.json are rooted at the host HOME; with it unset they resolve to the filesystem root. Open this folder from a POSIX shell -- Linux, macOS or WSL, not a Windows-side window -- then rebuild. See .devcontainer/docs/WOLFRAM_GUIDE.md.' >&2; exit 1; fi; mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/wolfram/engine/14.3" "$HOME/.local/wolfram/userbase" "$HOME/.cache/Wolfram" || { echo 'devcontainer FATAL: cannot create the Wolfram host directories under HOME -- check permissions and free space, then rebuild.' >&2; exit 1; }; echo 'devcontainer: host Wolfram directories ready.'
onCreateCommand: npm install -g cspell && uv python install && uv sync --all-extras && bash .devcontainer/scripts/setup-swap.sh
postCreateCommand: sudo chown vscode:vscode /home/vscode/.claude /home/vscode/.Wolfram /home/vscode/.cache /home/vscode/.local /home/vscode/.local/wolfram && sudo rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/yarn.list && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y libfontconfig1 libfreetype6 libx11-6 libxext6 libxcb1 libxkbcommon0 libxkbcommon-x11-0 ca-certificates curl gfortran && if [ "$INSTALL_TEX" = "true" ]; then sudo apt-get install -y texlive-latex-base texlive-latex-recommended texlive-latex-extra texlive-fonts-recommended texlive-fonts-extra cm-super ghostscript latexmk dvisvgm dvipng texlive-xetex texlive-luatex texlive-science texlive-bibtex-extra chktex texlive-extra-utils libyaml-tiny-perl libfile-homedir-perl liblog-log4perl-perl liblog-dispatch-perl libunicode-linebreak-perl; fi && sudo apt-get clean && sudo rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* && bash .devcontainer/scripts/setup-wolfram-links.sh && bash .devcontainer/scripts/notify-install-extensions.sh && bash .devcontainer/scripts/sync-claude-memory.sh restore && bash .devcontainer/scripts/reindex-claude-sessions.sh && (bash .devcontainer/scripts/install-lsp-wl.sh || echo 'Wolfram LSP paclets NOT installed -- run: bash .devcontainer/scripts/install-lsp-wl.sh') && (bash scripts/psalter/ensure_registered.sh || echo 'PSALTer resources NOT registered -- run: bash scripts/psalter/ensure_registered.sh')
